EIP-2780 把转账日志费用并入 TX_VALUE_COST
Starknet Falcon-512 账户主网转账
summary: EIP-8141 继续收敛：P256 签名要求 low-s 规范形式、VERIFY frame 静态排除在原子批次之外，两项均提交并合并；svlachakis 提交 frame 交易 blob 支持的完整规定。misilva73 合并 EIP-2780 修改，移除单独的 `TRANSFER_LOG_COST`（1756），`TX_VALUE_COST` 从 4244 提高到 6000，同时覆盖接收方和 EIP-7708 转账日志。Starknet 上符合规范的 Falcon-512 账户完成主网转账，约 0.06 美元。

items.topic: EIP-8141 的签名、批次与 blob
items.title: EIP-8141：固定 P256 签名规范形式（low-s）
items.note: （svlachakis）提交并合并。SECP256K1 路径已固定恢复 id 和 EIP-2 low-s，P256 没有对应规则，而 P256VERIFY 预编译（EIP-7951）同时接受 `s` 和 `n − s`；签名条目的原始字节是交易身份的一部分，不固定会带来可塑性。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: pin the P256 signature canonicality (low-s)
items.note_en: (svlachakis), submitted and merged. The SECP256K1 path already pins the recovery id and EIP-2 low-s, but P256 had no equivalent rule, and the P256VERIFY precompile (EIP-7951) accepts both `s` and `n − s`; a signature entry's raw bytes are part of the transaction's identity, so leaving this open allows malleability.

items.title_en: EIP-8141: statically exclude VERIFY frames from atomic batches
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged, clarifying the wording of the ban on VERIFY in batches.

items.topic: EIP-8141 的签名、批次与 blob
items.title: EIP-8141：规定 frame 交易的 blob 支持
items.note: （svlachakis）提交。费用部分已有（`tx_fee` 中的 `blob_fees`，`TXPARAM` `0x05`/`0x07`），缺的是包含有效性、区块级 blob gas 计数和网络形式；大部分引用 EIP-4844/EIP-7594，由付款方承担 blob 费用。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: specify blob support for frame transactions
items.note_en: (svlachakis), submitted. The fee side already existed (`blob_fees` in `tx_fee`, `TXPARAM` `0x05`/`0x07`); missing were inclusion validity, block-level blob gas accounting and the networking form. Most of it is EIP-4844/EIP-7594 by reference, with the payer as the blob-fee payer.

items.title: EIP-2780：把转账日志费用并入 TX_VALUE_COST
items.note: （misilva73）提交并合并：移除 `TRANSFER_LOG_COST`（1756），`TX_VALUE_COST` 从 4244 变为 6000，同时覆盖接收方和 EIP-7708 转账日志；带 value 的创建交易成本随之变化，规范和测试需更新。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: fold transfer log cost into TX_VALUE_COST
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted and merged: `TRANSFER_LOG_COST` (1756) is removed and `TX_VALUE_COST` goes from 4244 to 6000, covering both the recipient and the EIP-7708 transfer log; the cost of a create transaction with value changes, and specs and tests need updating.

keywords_en: VERIFY frames statically excluded from atomic batches
EIP-2780 folds transfer log cost into TX_VALUE_COST
summary_en: EIP-8141 kept converging: P256 signatures must use the canonical low-s form and VERIFY frames are statically excluded from atomic batches, both submitted and merged; svlachakis submitted a full specification of blob support for frame transactions. misilva73 merged an EIP-2780 change removing the standalone `TRANSFER_LOG_COST` (1756) and raising `TX_VALUE_COST` from 4244 to 6000 to cover both the recipient and the EIP-7708 transfer log. A spec-compliant Falcon-512 account made a mainnet transfer on Starknet for about $0.06.
